idea-plugin.name: Composer Designer
idea-plugin.description: Visual designer for Compose Multiplatform code. Opens Kotlin files containing @Composable functions in a split editor (like Compose Preview) whose Design pane is the Composer canvas: edit the UI visually and the plugin regenerates the Kotlin code deterministically. Code the designer can't represent is preserved verbatim as locked blocks — it never destroys code it doesn't understand.
